newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Five killed, 46 injured in Philippine bus crashes.
newsitem.headline: Five killed, 46 injured in Philippine bus crashes.

text.p: Five people were killed and 46 injured in two bus crashes in the Philippines on Monday, police said.

In the first accident, a passenger bus plunged into a 30-metre (100 ft) ravine in the mountain resort city of Baguio, 200 km (124 miles) north of capital Manila, shortly after midday when the driver lost control on a winding road, police said.
Three people died and about 40 were injured, police said.
In the second accident, two people died and six were injured when a bus rammed into a bus station in the Philippine capital during the morning rush hour.

Figures released recently by the police show road accidents in the Philippines surged 91 percent in the first six months of this year to 8,349, compared with 4,409 in the same period last year, police said.
